purpose: Teach: 標本/返却/動き出し/没頭/書斎/切り捨て/開講/社名

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の標本、社内に展示しろ。
lines.en: Get the new product samples displayed in the office.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact delivery. Sharp attack on the first word. Brief pause before the action. Expectation of compliance without ceremony.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。賃借品の返却、忘れずに進めます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the leased items get returned without delay.
lines.style: Crisp, professional acknowledgment. Slight lean forward — showing readiness. Steady pacing. A quiet assurance that this is noted and handled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト、動き出した。
lines.style: Announcement pitch — clear and authoritative. A light emphasis on 'moving.' Direct eye-contact delivery. No elaboration needed; the information stands alone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担当が没頭できるよう、環境整えます。
lines.en: I'll clear the decks so the team lead can focus on the work.
lines.style: Steady, supportive tone. Measured pace — not rushed. Slight incline of head showing engagement with the task. A hint of initiative beneath the courteous surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 私の書斎にも、報告書、置いておけ。
lines.en: And leave reports in my study as well.
lines.style: Short, decisive. Added detail without ceremony. A small notch of finality at the end. The tone of someone accustomed to having their preferences anticipated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 不要部署、切り捨てるか、判断が要りそうです。
lines.en: It looks like we'll need to make a call on whether to consolidate or cut the underperforming divisions.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured, careful phrasing — weighing options aloud. Slight hesitation on the decision point, acknowledging the weight of the choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新講座、来月開講だ。社名も周知させろ。
lines.en: The new training program launches next month. Make sure the company name gets out there.
lines.style: Direct, two-beat statement. Slight lift on the launch timeline. The second sentence spoken with brisk efficiency — a delegation more than a suggestion.
